what_this_is: The seventeen saved 8.01 items outside the seven windows e01-keyword-branch/eight-o-one-judgements.json covers (JPMorgan 8, Paramount 8, Salesforce 1), each read in full from its own text by eye. Kept apart from that file because its reader fails on a judgement about a filing its windows do not hold. Same question and same two decisions: does the item report a merger, acquisition or business combination the registrant or a subsidiary is party to - announced, agreed or completed.

0001104659-25-123496.judgement: Paramount Skydance announced the amendment and extension of its previously announced tender offer for all outstanding Series A shares of Warner Bros. Discovery - an acquisition offer the registrant makes. No declared alias occurs in the item: it says 'tender offer' and 'shares of ... Warner Bros. Discovery'.

0001193125-25-310710.judgement: Paramount Skydance announced its proposal 'to acquire all of the outstanding shares of common stock of Warner Bros. Discovery'. An announced proposal, not an agreement; no declared alias occurs - 'acquire' does not contain 'acquisition'.

0000813828-24-000009.judgement: Paramount subsidiaries agreed to sell their entire 13.01% equity interest in Viacom 18 to Reliance Industries for about $517 million, defined as 'the Transaction' - a disposition by sale agreement. The alias hit is the defined term 'Transaction'; no named-counterparty pattern ('acquisition of X', 'merger with X') occurs.

0000813828-24-000018.judgement: Paramount issued a press release filed as Exhibit 99; the item's own text says nothing else. The exhibit is not saved, so what it announces is not read here.

0000813828-24-000033.judgement: Compensation actions for the Office of the CEO appointments (severance plan participation, target bonus).

0000813828-24-000073.judgement: Compensation changes for the co-CEOs, cross-referring to Item 5.02.

0000813828-24-000081.judgement: Paramount Global 'completed the previously announced sale of its entire 13.01% equity interest in Viacom 18 Media Private Limited to Reliance Industries Limited' for $508 million - the completion of the disposition agreed in 0000813828-24-000009. No declared alias occurs in the item.

0000813828-24-000087.judgement: Accelerated vesting of executives' RSUs and PSUs to mitigate the section 280G impact. The alias hit is 'Transaction Agreement', naming the pending Skydance merger agreement under which the PSUs convert; the item reports compensation decisions made because of that transaction, not the transaction.

0001108524-25-000083.judgement: A $20.0 billion increase in the share repurchase authorization. The alias hit is 'open market transactions', the repurchase methods.
